name: udf-mail-app
description: UDF Party councillor secure mail — a hardened Capacitor WebView wrapper around https://mail.udf-party.co.za (Roundcube). Single-purpose: INTERNET-only, HTTPS-only, FLAG_SECURE, non-debuggable release signed with the UDF upload key.

scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && npm run android:assets && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && npm run android:assets && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain :app:assembleRelease
